newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian death squad kills four peasants.
newsitem.headline: Colombian death squad kills four peasants.

text.p: A right-wing death squad killed four peasants on Saturday and threatened to murder others if they did not abandon a village in northern Colombia, military sources said.
Witnesses said a gang of heavily-armed men dragged the victims from their homes in Puerto Coca, in Bolivar province, and riddled them with bullets, an army spokesman said.

The gunmen, claiming to be members of the Peasant Self-Defence Group of Cordoba and Sucre, ransacked a number of small shops and then threatened to slay anybody left in the village in 30 days time, the spokesman said.

The raid was the latest in a string of copycat attacks across northern Colombia by paramilitary groups, all of which appear to be tied to the most-feared death squad, the Peasant Self-Defence Group of Cordoba and Uraba, headed by rancher Carlos Castano.

Human rights groups accuse the army of sponsoring and helping organise the death squads to wage a scorched earth policy against leftist guerrillas and their suspected sympathisers, in which they carry out extrajudicial killings and clear entire villages.
The army has denied any institutional links, although military chiefs have admitted that some lower-ranking officers may have forged personal ties with paramilitary groups.
